Born from a cursed experiment known as Rape Rodent, Trollface became the undisputed King of Internet Mayhem — the grinning embodiment of chaos, derailing threads, spawning rage comics, and turning normies into seething rage machines with a single “Problem?” His power was simple yet unstoppable: pure, unfiltered trolling that spread across forums, YouTube, Reddit, and eventually the entire digital realm. But every king needs a queen. While Trollface ruled the shadows, a new force was awakening. In forgotten corners of DeviantArt and early Reddit, Mrs. Troll (Trollina) manifested. With her flowing midnight hair, razor-sharp eyelashes, sly half-lidded eyes, and that same signature toothy grin — now accented with a touch of rebellious pink blush and lipstick — she was no mere side character. She was the feminine chaos incarnate. Where Trollface trolled with brute force, Mrs. Troll trolled with elegance, precision, and devastating wit. She flipped shipping wars, exposed hypocrisy in comment sections, and left trails of “U Mad, Sis?” that echoed for years.
